description: A Spring Boot REST controller class handling HTTP requests related to performance reviews, providing endpoints to create, update, retrieve, list, and delete review data. It includes security annotations for role-based access control and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ReviewController
classes.description: Controller class that maps HTTP endpoints related to performance reviews, secured with role-based access, and annotated for API documentation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new review, accessible only by users with the ADMIN role.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing review identified by ID, accessible only by ADMIN.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a review by ID, accessible by ADMIN and USER roles.

methods.name: listByEmployee
methods.description: Lists all reviews for a specific employee, accessible by ADMIN and USER.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a review by ID, accessible only by ADMIN.
